overrides.title: Pentecost Promised, Proclaimed, and Practiced
overrides.speaker: Rob Hammann
overrides.description: In Acts 1–3, we see Pentecost promised, proclaimed, and practiced. This message explores how the Holy Spirit was not poured out merely for a moment to celebrate, but for a life to live—empowering believers to witness boldly, love authentically, pray faithfully, and embody the presence of Jesus in everyday life.
